description: This Kotlin source file defines a SettingsFragment class for an Android app. The fragment displays a list of settings items (Account, Network, About) which are interactive; clicking shows a Toast message, and focus changes change background and text colors for TV navigation.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of settings options (Account, Network, About) and handles user interactions with focus and click events.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from R.layout.fragment_settings.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the list of setting item views, sets focus and click handlers that show toast messages and change visual focus styles.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of SettingsFragment.
